propositions: The eight-phrase _CONTEXT_LEN_HINTS tuple is duplicated byte-for-byte in failure.py and sizing.py, creating a maintenance risk where fixes to one silently leave the other stale

sizing.is_context_limit_error must remain as a function definition in plan_review/sizing.py because orchestrator.py imports it at module load time and test_plan_review_prerequisites_model_log.py monkeypatches it by string name
sizing.py should import _CONTEXT_LEN_HINTS from failure.py instead of maintaining its own local copy, with no import cycle since failure.py only imports rebar.llm.errors
A uniqueness guard test must detect when the eight-phrase conjunction appears in more than one file under src/rebar, while exempting the owner file and honouring escape markers

Three legitimate intentional divergences must remain untouched: _is_token_exhaustion in completion_failures.py (omits bare 'context' substring intentionally), _BAD_STOP_REASONS in structured.py (different key space from message_for), and special cases in _llm_commands.py and close_precheck.py
